app_info.update_message: Naya SEO Algorithm update aaya hai. Behtar views aur reach ke liye update karein.

remote_prompts.master_seo_prompt: Act as an elite YouTube SEO strategist strictly engineered for the 2026 YouTube search and recommendation algorithm. For the target topic [USER_TOPIC], generate a full metadata package: 1. 5 High-CTR click-worthy titles (40-60 characters, curiosity gap, brackets [2026], emotional trigger). 2. Long-tail keyword optimized description with 2-line hook before the fold, structured chapter timestamps, creator links, and channel hashtags. 3. 20 high-ranking semantic tags under 490 characters. 4. 5 hyper-targeted trending hashtags. 5. A 3-second viral hook script (visual cue + verbal pattern interrupt). 6. An algorithmic pinned comment with an open loop question to drive comment velocity.
remote_prompts.title_prompt: Generate 5 high-CTR (15%+), click-worthy YouTube titles for [USER_TOPIC] strictly under 60 characters. Use extreme curiosity gaps, brackets [2026], numbers, and power emotion words. Avoid generic clickbait.
remote_prompts.description_prompt: Generate a high-converting YouTube description for [USER_TOPIC]. First 2 lines must be an irresistible hook before Show More. Follow with semantic LSI keyword paragraphs, structured chapter timestamps, creator social links, and relevant tags.
remote_prompts.tags_prompt: Generate 20 high-search-volume, long-tail semantic tags for [USER_TOPIC]. Format strictly as comma-separated values totaling under 490 characters. No numbering or hashtags.
remote_prompts.hashtags_prompt: Generate 5 trending, high-velocity YouTube hashtags for [USER_TOPIC] prefixed with #. Prioritize niche-specific and algorithm-trending tags.
remote_prompts.hook_script_prompt: Write a 3-second viral retention hook script for [USER_TOPIC]. Provide both a visual pattern interrupt (what viewer sees on screen) and a verbal hook sentence that eliminates the curiosity gap without spoiling the climax.
remote_prompts.pinned_comment_prompt: Craft an algorithmic engagement pinned comment for [USER_TOPIC]. Use a conversational open loop and a polarizing or curious question that compels viewers to reply immediately.
remote_prompts.viral_strategy_prompt: Provide a YouTube 2026 algorithm blueprint for [USER_TOPIC]: optimal video duration, pacing rules to retain 60%+ APV at 30 seconds, and thumbnail-title synergy rules for browse features.
remote_prompts.ai_coach_audit_prompt: Analyze the channel metadata and performance metrics for [USER_TOPIC]. Identify CTR bottlenecks, search ranking leaks, retention drop-off reasons, and provide 3 immediate fixes.

promoted_apps.app_desc: Best YouTube Tag, Hook & Metadata Generator
